Jahan Mein Sorah-e-Kausar Ki Jab Tafseer Bole Gi.
Tu Oss Tafseer Mein Shabar Ki Tasveer Bole Gi.

1
Mere Mula Hasan Ki Zair-e-Chadar Aa Tu Lene Do.
Malak Ke Bolne Se Pehle Khud Tatheer Bole Gi.
Hasan Ne Sulho Nama Likh Ke Khamoshi Se Batlaya.
Keh Hara Kon Yeh Qirtas Ki Tehreer Bole Gi.

2
Hasan Bole Harees-e-Sham Ko Qaidi Bana Loon Ga.
Qalam Ban Jaye Ga Zanjeer Tu Zanjeer Bole Gi.
Rahon Ga Qabar Mein Main Mutmain Khamosh Aye Majid.
Mere Likhe Howay Ashar Ki Tehreer Bole Gi.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/jahan-mein-sorah-e-kausar-ki-jab-tafseer-bole-gi-tajpoints-2024fe8996c40df0d0b0.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---\\n')[2].strip()
metadata, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---\\n')[1:]
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert roman.casefold() == old.replace('.\\n', '\\n').removesuffix('.').casefold()
for edition in (roman, body.strip()):
    assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in edition.split('\\n\\n')] == [2, 5, 5]
assert [block.splitlines()[0] for block in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')[1:]] == ['۱', '۲']
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Verified Roman wording and alignment across all 10 verses.')
